title: centaurium madrense
intro: Centaurium madrense, commonly known as Mountain Bluet, is a flowering plant species within the Gentianaceae family. The plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is primarily used to treat urinary tract infections, kidney stones, and other kidney-related issues, due to its diuretic and anti-inflammatory effects. The health benefits of Centaurium madrense include its ability to alleviate symptoms of kidney stones, such as pain and discomfort, as well as its antioxidant properties which may help protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Centaurium madrense include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and iridoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including diuretic, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
